alternative_explanations: A compact learned encoder may merely reconstruct the same empirical predictive quotient as CSSR or bisimulation with extra optimization cost.
Spectral compression may win through linear algebra on this finite-rank generator rather than through a generally transferable representation principle.
confounds: Visible synthetic transducer, one seed, finite alphabet, modal rather than fully probabilistic prediction, and generated coverage may make state identification easier than open-world perception.
The latent-state oracle is capability-only and is not a deployable cost baseline.
falsification_criteria: Any learned representation merges decision-distinct near histories or falls below 0.95 prediction, planning, update, or retention accuracy.
Every exact learned representation is dominated in workload and state by a matched CSSR, spectral PSR, context-tree, or empirical-bisimulation control.

outcome_policy.negative: Discard the tested learned representations without repair if they make unsafe state merges, fail held-out action compositions, or forget unchanged behavior after local update.
outcome_policy.null: Retain predictive-state abstraction as classical infrastructure but return HYP-0008 to dormant if learned routes only match a cheaper classical quotient.
outcome_policy.positive: Keep HYP-0008 testing and preregister a multi-seed adversarial screen only if a learned state is capability-matched and full-system non-dominated.

predicted_outcome: At least one learned predictive encoder will recover behaviorally sufficient state from raw aliased histories and retain calibrated OOD decisions, but strong CSSR, spectral PSR or empirical bisimulation may match it once acquisition, fit, state, rollout and update costs are charged.
promotion_criteria: Quick cannot promote; it may only justify a three-seed adversarial screen if a learned route is exact or calibrated-safe and non-dominated on full workload against all classical controls.
research_question: Can a learned compact predictive state discovered without latent labels preserve OOD action-conditioned prediction, short planning and local updates at lower full-system cost than strong classical causal-state and spectral controls?
title: Predictive equivalence learned from raw action-observation histories
